class.name: SteamCheatReport
class.brief_description: One detached Valve report identity and its known app and target context.
class.description: Returned by [method SteamPublisherModeration.report] or within [SteamCheatReportPage]. A report is evidence for review. The trusted game retains the match and reviewer context.

method.name: get_report_id
method.description: Returns valve's report ID in unsigned decimal form.

method.name: get_app_id
method.description: Returns the publisher AppID that scoped the report.

method.name: get_match_id
method.description: Returns the game-owned match reference when available from local submission.

method.name: get_reason_code
method.description: Returns the game-defined report reason code, or zero when unavailable.

method.name: get_reported_at_unix
method.description: Returns the Valve report timestamp in Unix seconds, or zero when unavailable.
